preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns in the labyrinth must be between 1 and 2000.
The starting cell must be within the bounds of the labyrinth.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the left and right must be non-negative and within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in labyrinth) and all(cell in '.*' for row in labyrinth for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each row of the labyrinth must have length m and consist only of '.' and '*' characters.
The starting cell must be a free cell.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of reachable cells from the starting cell.
